test_title: PYST 37: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e93e9f830c2d35db93b90a7c6a8b4092ade04b59693b44d0906a4456291d2da.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -3, +7.

Let’s check each option:

1. JD-GK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7051a1f7e8e439bc3e1ba72b7b89056610fc156ee12b8e0e957032fee9229de9.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -3, +7.

2. NH-KO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a88413ab6b1e9f0e94162a22e4bcc2f66d191b10998a227b01f005f5338e75fa.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -3, +7.

3. LF-IM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d21c68ce14e7881bce61ceced1ec9d49c8649fce3ca0fd9eb2767e1ae273813d.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -3, +7.

4. GA-DI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09602cec7251454f727bf730493b931c742479161e850d618bf0341ec176b720.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern -3, +7.

Thus, GA-DI is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
